name: Three person Jim's feasts (and lunch boxes) (introduction)
chapter: Three person Jim's feasts (and lunch boxes)

body.h: These patterns are feasts with one juggler throwing straight passes, one juggler throwing crossing passes and one juggler throwing straight passes to one person and crossing passes to the other.

Relabel the beats in Clare's pattern in each feast, to get an associated lunch box pattern. In these patterns each juggler throws straight passes to their right and crossing passes to their left or vice-versa.
